{{Hatnote|This is the dated constructed pool of January – September 2014. For the fixed pre-reset pool played since 2014, see [[Legacy Open]]. For all pools of this era, see [[Virtual Legacy#Constructed pools|Virtual Legacy]].}}
'''Premiere - Virtual Block 9.1''' is the constructed card pool of every Decipher card plus the [[Players Committee]] virtual cards through [[Republic At War (Virtual Block 9)|Virtual Block 9.1: Republic At War]]. The Players Committee released 9.1 on 10 January 2014: "The new cards are legal immediately for casual and competitive play."<ref name="wp91">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/v-set-9-1-is-live/ V-set 9.1 is live!], Players Committee (10 January 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20140114065911/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/wp/v-set-9-1-is-live/ Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pdf91">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock9_1.pdf ''Virtual Block 9: Republic At War''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of January 10, 2014". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174637/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock9_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> It was the last dated pool of the [[Virtual Legacy]] era. On 25 July 2014 the Players Committee announced the "Reset of Standard Format", and on 25 September 2014 the first post-reset cards became "legal immediately for play in Standard Format".<ref name="reset">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/reset-of-standard-format/ Reset of Standard Format], Players Committee, Advocate Council (byline darkjediknight11) (25 July 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20141020142523/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/wp/reset-of-standard-format/ Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="resetpdf">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/pdf-of-reset-list-posted-virtual-set-0-and-virtual-set-1-preview/ PDF of Reset List Posted – Virtual Set 0 and Virtual Set 1 Preview], Players Committee (25 September 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20141009180356/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/wp/pdf-of-reset-list-posted-virtual-set-0-and-virtual-set-1-preview/ Internet Archive]</ref> The pre-reset cards became the fixed Legacy format, which this wiki calls [[Legacy Open]].<ref name="reset" /> Until the reset, the Players Committee's name for this constructed format was ''Standard''.

* '''Type:''' constructed
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee
* '''Card pool:''' every Decipher card plus Virtual Blocks 1–8 and Virtual Block 9.1
* '''In use:''' 10 January 2014 – 24 September 2014 (the last pool before the 2014 reset)
* '''GEMP:''' none (GEMP's ''Legacy'' environment is the later fixed pool, [[Legacy Open]])

== History ==
Republic At War is "the first set in our V9 'Clone Wars' theme".<ref name="wp91" /> It has 77 card slips (34 Dark Side, 43 Light Side); each of its two objectives takes two slips.<ref name="w-raw" /> Some of its cards were already in the pool as the 2013 V9.1 Preview Set (see [[Premiere - Virtual Block 8.3]]).

'''Virtual Block 9.2.''' A PDF of [[Twilight Of The Republic (Virtual Block 9)|Virtual Block 9.2: Twilight Of The Republic]] (11 cards) has official text as of 14 July 2014.<ref name="pdf92">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock9_2.pdf ''Virtual Block 9: Twilight Of The Republic''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of July 14, 2014". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020184720/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock9_2.pdf?copy=2 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="w-totr">[[Twilight Of The Republic (Virtual Block 9)]]</ref> On 25 July 2014 the Players Committee wrote: "9.2 will not be released in its current form. We are planning on releasing a mini, 12 card set for Worlds."<ref name="reset" /> No release post for 9.2 was found: in the Players Committee's news the post before the reset announcement is "V-set 9.1 is live!".<ref name="reset" /> The Players Committee's virtual-slips page as captured on 24 August 2014, during the [[2014 World Championship]], lists no 9.2 PDF.<ref name="slips2014">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Virtual slips], Players Committee (page as captured 24 August 2014, during the 2014 World Championship). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20140824215402/http://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Internet Archive]</ref> Whether 9.2, or a mini set for Worlds, was ever tournament legal is unknown, so this wiki treats 9.1 as the last dated pool.

'''The reset.''' The 25 July 2014 announcement said: "The new Standard tournament format will consist of all post-reset V Cards ... we also will create a new Legacy format for tournament events ... which will consist of all pre-Reset v cards. It will be a fixed-cardpool format that tournament directors can run at their discretion." It also planned a beta test of the reset format at a side event at Worlds in Toronto and at the European Championship in September 2014.<ref name="reset" /> On 25 September 2014 the Players Committee posted the Virtual Set 0 and Virtual Set 1 Preview PDFs and added: "A Legacy (pre-Reset) pdf may be wrapped up soon for any who wish to use those cards from time to time still (but not in Standard format events)."<ref name="resetpdf" /> From then on the post-2014 Standard format is [[Open]], and the pre-reset pool is the fixed [[Legacy Open]]. See [[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset]].
